title: GitStatus
description: What git says about the folder.

ahead.description: Commits the branch has that its upstream lacks.

behind.description: Commits the upstream has that the branch lacks.

branch.description: The current branch; `None` when `HEAD` is detached.

changed.description: Changed files, relative to the folder.

head.description: The commit `HEAD` points at; `None` in a repository with no commits.

merge_in_progress.description: Whether a merge is half done.

private_tracked.description: Tracked paths under `.omuzaki/`, which should stay private.

from.description: The old path, relative to the folder, `/`-separated.

oneOf.description: Both sides of a merge changed it.

CommitId.description: A full object id: 40 (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256) lowercase hex characters.
